title: IFC unit assignment
description: What the numbers in the file were written in. This describes the properties and quantities, not the geometry: the mesh coordinates are metres whatever the file used, because that is what the geometry engine reports.

expressId.description: The line number of the IfcUnitAssignment.

geometryUnit.description: The unit the converted mesh coordinates are in. Always METRE.

assignments.description: Unit type to the unit named for it, such as { "LENGTHUNIT": "MILLI METRE", "AREAUNIT": "SQUARE_METRE" }. A conversion-based unit is named along with the factor it converts by.
